a: Direct costs up to $500,000 per year; up to 5 years; about 3 awards, $2,000,000 total.
dt: Due Aug 21, 2027 (then Aug 21, 2028), 5 pm local time; the Aug 21, 2026 date has passed. NOFO expires Aug 22, 2028.
e: Development or adaptation of high-resolution non-invasive or minimally invasive imaging (optical, acoustic, molecular, endoscopic and other methods) of the living human olfactory system; teams combining imaging, bioengineering and biophysics are encouraged. Foreign organizations and foreign components are not eligible.
n: NIH: Transformative Non-Invasive/Minimally Invasive Technologies for Imaging the Olfactory System Across Scales (R01, RFA-DC-27-003)
